purpose: Name replaceable painter models and transports without allowing a model to own scene meaning.

z_image_turbo.label: Z-Image Turbo
z_image_turbo.notes: Default Velastra brush: efficient, instruction-following, and practical for repeated room iteration.

promptDialect.philosophy: Translate Virynism into visible material evidence rather than abstract adjectives.
directives: State the room's concrete physical facts before atmospheric interpretation.
Translate memory through treatment of scene-permitted surfaces and materials: patina, residue, wear, interrupted marks, layered pigment, and spatial evidence.

Translate sacred incompletion through treatment of existing works and surfaces: exposed grounds, partial passages, erased marks, unfinished edges, and interrupted process rather than blank objects alone.
Translate threshold into depth at an existing edge or scene-permitted spatial feature: corridor, veil, shadow, reflection, recession, opening, or unresolved continuation.
Prefer purposeful asymmetry and uneven negative space over centered showroom balance.
Use one dominant impossible or emotionally dissonant fact only when supported by scene truth rather than multiplying fantasy effects.
Keep the scene painterly and tactile; avoid generic cinematic concept-art polish.

provenance.source: Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo prompting guide and Z-Image model comparison

qwen_image.label: Qwen Image
qwen_image.notes: Heavier alternate brush for comparison and high-fidelity trials.

promptDialect.philosophy: Preserve hierarchy and scene truth while expanding Virynism into layered visual relationships.
directives: Honor the focal hierarchy explicitly and keep secondary details subordinate.
Render abstract meaning through treatment of scene-permitted material, space, light, and gesture rather than by inventing new props.
Keep unresolved marks and partial process visible on existing works and surfaces where Virynism asks for incompletion.
Use asymmetry, layered depth, and scene-supported residue to avoid showroom composition.
Let symbolic meaning remain implicit in materials and light rather than explicit iconography.

qwen_image_edit.label: Qwen Image Edit
qwen_image_edit.notes: Reference-capable brush for translating approved Virynism witnesses into a new scene without allowing witness content to become scene truth.

promptDialect.philosophy: Treat the input image as evidence of visual decision-making, never as scene content to preserve.
directives: Rebuild the target scene from its authoritative scene truth and visible evidence contract.
Use the witness only for matched visual roles such as light, compositional cadence, edge behavior, tonal memory, material handling, spatial depth, intimate presence, or sacred incompletion.
Do not preserve witness subjects, identities, objects, architecture, symbols, furniture, or layout unless independently required by target scene truth.
When witness content conflicts with target scene truth, target scene truth wins completely.
Translate the witness hand through new material decisions rather than copying its composition.

negativePrompt.policy: critical scene and inheritance boundaries remain positive

controlContract.refusalStrategy: state target facts and non-inheritance positively

provenance.source: Hugging Face Inference Providers image-to-image + Qwen Image Edit documentation
